verses.text: Hear ye the word which Jehovah speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

segments.text: Hear ye the word which Jehovah speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

verses.text: thus saith Jehovah, Learn not the way of the nations, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the nations are dismayed at them.

segments.text: thus saith Jehovah, Learn not the way of the nations, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the nations are dismayed at them.

verses.text: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe.

segments.text: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe.

verses.text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

segments.text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

verses.text: They are like a palm-tree, of turned work, and speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither is it in them to do good.

verses.text: There is none like unto thee, O Jehovah; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.

segments.text: There is none like unto thee, O Jehovah; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.

verses.text: Who should not fear thee, O King of the nations? for to thee doth it appertain; forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is none like unto thee.

segments.text: Who should not fear thee, O King of the nations? for to thee doth it appertain; forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is none like unto thee.

verses.text: But they are together brutish and foolish: the instruction of idols! it is but a stock.

segments.text: But they are together brutish and foolish: the instruction of idols! it is but a stock.

verses.text: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the artificer and of the hands of the goldsmith; blue and purple for their clothing; they are all the work of skilful men.

verses.text: But Jehovah is the true God; he is the living God, and an everlasting King: at his wrath the earth trembleth, and the nations are not able to abide his indignation.

segments.text: But Jehovah is the true God; he is the living God, and an everlasting King: at his wrath the earth trembleth, and the nations are not able to abide his indignation.

verses.text: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, these shall perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.

segments.text: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, these shall perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.

verses.text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding hath he stretched out the heavens.

segments.text: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding hath he stretched out the heavens.

verses.text: When he uttereth his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.text: Every man is become brutish and is without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his graven image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

verses.text: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth from me, and they are not: there is none to spread my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

verses.text: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name; for they have devoured Jacob, yea, they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.
